summary: Frontend-only testing of mobile hamburger menu, desktop nav, and favicon on Astro portfolio site. All requested behaviors work correctly.

test_results.mobile_hamburger_visible_no_logo: PASS - toggle visible at 390x844, no logo element in header
test_results.hamburger_opens_menu: PASS - aria-expanded=true, .open class applied, About link visible/clickable
test_results.link_click_navigates_and_closes_menu: PASS - navigated to /about, menu closed (aria-expanded=false, .open removed)
test_results.desktop_shows_main_nav_hides_toggle: PASS - main-nav visible at 1440x900, mobile toggle hidden, no logo
test_results.favicon_svg: PASS - GET /favicon.svg returns 200 with SVG containing <path> (radical) and text 'a' (teal #2dd4bf on dark #241d2f rounded rect)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI behaviors (mobile hamburger animation via aria-expanded + .open class, menu link close on navigation, desktop nav visibility, favicon SVG) validated on preview URL. Note: Playwright is_visible() returned True on the closed mobile menu because its container still occupies layout with max-height:0/opacity transition; correct behavior confirmed via aria-expanded attribute and .open class checks instead.
